issue.title: Bug: SFP thermal threshold test fails when passive copper transceivers report N/A DOM thresholds

failure.body:
### Is it platform specific

broadcom

### Importance or Severity

Medium

### Description of the bug

 `platform_tests/test_sfp_thermal_state_db.py::TestSfpThermalStateDb::test_sfp_thresholds_match_xcvrd_tables` can fail on platforms using passive copper/DAC transceivers.

  xcvrd creates TRANSCEIVER_DOM_THRESHOLD rows for these ports, but all temperature threshold fields can be non-numeric/ N/A. In this case there are no numeric DOM temperature threshold values to compare with show platform temperature output.

  The test should skip only when all affected ports are passive copper transceivers and no numeric DOM temperature thresholds are available. It should still fail if any non-passive-copper or unknown transceiver is present, so real optical transceiver threshold bugs are not hidden.

### Steps to Reproduce

 Run the following test on a DUT populated with passive copper/DAC transceivers (  Arista DCS-7050CX3-32S with passive copper/DAC transceivers )
platform_tests/test_sfp_thermal_state_db.py::TestSfpThermalStateDb::test_sfp_thresholds_match_xcvrd_tables

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

**Actual behavior:**
  The test attempts to validate thermal threshold data even when all DOM temperature threshold values are non-numeric/N/A for passive copper transceivers.

  **Expected behavior:**
  The test should skip when:
  1. No numeric SFP thermal threshold rows are available from CLI output.
  2. TRANSCEIVER_DOM_THRESHOLD contains no numeric temperature threshold values.
  3. All affected ports are passive copper/DAC transceivers.

  The test should fail if non-passive-copper or unknown transceivers are present without numeric thresholds.

### Relevant log output

```shell
The error

Failed: Only 0/0 SFP rows had thresholds matching TRANSCEIVER_DOM_THRESHOLD. At least 1 required. CLI SFP rows: 64, DOM threshold ports: 64
```

### Approach

#### What is the motivation for this PR?
`test_sfp_thresholds_match_xcvrd_tables` fails on platforms populated
  with passive copper/DAC transceivers when all DOM temperature threshold
  fields are reported as N/A.

  Example failure:

`Failed: Only 0/0 SFP rows had thresholds matching TRANSCEIVER_DOM_THRESHOLD.
 At least 1 required. CLI SFP rows: 64, DOM threshold ports: 64`

#### How did you do it?
Used the existing `get_passive_cable_port_list()` helper to identify passive copper transceiver ports.

 The test skips only when:
  1. No CLI SFP rows contain numeric threshold values.
  2. No numeric TRANSCEIVER_DOM_THRESHOLD temperature values are present.
  3. All ports with DOM threshold rows are passive copper transceivers.

If any non-passive-copper or unknown transceiver is present, the test
fails instead of skipping.

#### How did you verify/test it?
Verified on affected DUTs that the test skips with:
`No numeric TRANSCEIVER_DOM_THRESHOLD temperature values available for passive copper transceivers`

Also verified on optical-transceiver DUTs from the test results that the test continues to pass normally
when numeric DOM temperature thresholds are present.

#### Any platform specific information?
Observed on Arista 7050CX3/7260CX3 platforms with passive copper/DAC transceivers.
